versions.content: The function FrIf_EnableAbsoluteTimerIRQ shall wrap the Flex Ray Driver API function Fr_EnableAbsoluteTimerIRQ() by: 1. Translating (based on static FrIf module configuration) the FlexRay CC index Fr If_CtrlIdx into a tuple (FlexRay Driver | Driver-specific CC index Fr_CtrlIdx). 2. Setting parameters (a) Fr_AbsTimerIdx to FrIf_AbsTimerIdx 3. Calling Fr_EnableAbsoluteTimerIRQ() of the determined FlexRay Driver module with the parameters determined as described above.
